$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md). Free sources only (no API key), and apify.com as the example: 121 subdomains on 2026-10-29, so a first run shows real results at a small cost.

tasks.name: subdomain-finder
tasks.title: Subdomain finder: every subdomain of a domain, checked in DNS
tasks.description: Find the subdomains of any domain from public sources (crt.sh, HackerTarget, RapidDNS and CertSpotter) with no API key, each one checked live in DNS, one row per subdomain. Type a domain or paste a URL; full URLs are cleaned. Add your own API keys to search the other 50 sources too.
tasks.seoTitle: Subdomain Finder - All Subdomains of a Domain
tasks.seoDescription: Find every subdomain of a domain from crt.sh, HackerTarget, RapidDNS and CertSpotter, each checked live in DNS. No API key needed, export to CSV or JSON.

tasks.name: certificate-transparency-subdomain-search
tasks.title: Certificate transparency search: subdomains from crt.sh logs
tasks.description: List the subdomains a domain's TLS certificates name, from the certificate transparency logs of crt.sh and CertSpotter, with each name checked live in DNS. A quick way to map a company's public attack surface or find forgotten hosts.
tasks.seoDescription: Subdomains from certificate transparency logs (crt.sh and CertSpotter), each checked live in DNS. Map an attack surface or find forgotten hosts.
